basics.name: Anand Bhaskaran
basics.label: AI Product Engineer | Production Agents & MCP | Real Estate + Regulated Fintech
basics.summary: AI product engineer who ships agents that real users actually rely on. At LumApps I own production multi-agent workflows on LangGraph + Google ADK with tools exposed over MCP (2x conversions, $1M forecast quarterly revenue). On the side I built Proplab, an AI-native product for real estate inspections and multilingual listings, and SwissNRI, an AI-native cross-border tax and compliance product (evals, refusals, and guardrails-before-features are default). 13+ years shipping to 10M+ users. Zurich-based, comfortable sitting with advisors for an afternoon and shipping the first agent in weeks.

work.name: LumApps
highlights: Took AI outbound from prototype to production: multi-agent workflows on Python, LangGraph, Google ADK with tools exposed over MCP and state streamed to the UI over AG-UI. Reps use it daily. 2x open rates, 2x approved opportunities, 2 to 3 hours saved per rep per day, $1M forecast in quarterly revenue.

Built the MCP layer over domain APIs: thin, well-designed tool wrappers agents act through. Same pattern the Neho JD describes; I was the first and most demanding consumer of our own API-first architecture.

Own the reliability layer: eval pipelines that reflect real usage, LangSmith tracing, cost-per-request telemetry, verification loops, refusal patterns, human-in-the-loop draft-before-send. Report directly to C-level.

work.name: Beekeeper AG
highlights: Replaced a $337K annual vendor contract with an in-house LLM pipeline shipped in 6 weeks (GitHub Actions + OpenAI). 12K+ assets translated. Classic prototype-to-production motion the Neho role calls for.

Built AI Onboarding Specialist: personalized high-touch guidance for every new signup. 100% of customers guided through setup, time-to-first-value cut without adding headcount. Discovery with product + CS, evals from day one.
Co-owned GTM launches with Product and Sales. Each shipped with instrumentation so we knew within a week if it moved the needle, and killed the ones that didn't.
Architected Employee Referral System end to end (Java, PostgreSQL, Elastic Search on Kubernetes). Became the platform's top revenue channel: $1.5M+ revenue, $500K ARR at 99.99% SLA.

work.name: Dronistics
highlights: Founding engineer for an EPFL spin-off. Shipped the full autonomous drone delivery platform (Vue/Java/PostgreSQL) that powered 500+ real-world deliveries. Sat with ops teams, mapped messy human workflows, turned them into working software.
Built AWS infrastructure and CI/CD pipeline from scratch. Enterprise-grade reliability that enabled a Unilever partnership and a CES showcase.

projects.name: Proplab - AI for Real Estate
projects.description: Property inspections run on paper, clipboards, and WhatsApp photos. Built an AI-native MVP that removes the toil end to end: a vision pipeline extracts structured signals (room type, condition, defects) from inspection photos, and LLM agents turn those records into multilingual, marketing-ready property listings in one workflow. Direct parallel to Neho's mandate: remove manual work so experts spend time on the moments that matter.

projects.name: SwissNRI - AI Cross-border Fintech (Regulated)
projects.description: AI-native cross-border tax and compliance platform for Swiss-Indian families. RAG-grounded assistant answers DTAA, FEMA and Swiss tax questions with citations back to regulation; compliance-first agentic design with refusal patterns and guardrails built before features. Zero-to-MVP in 3 months, 40% uplift in satisfaction. Same regulated, document-heavy discipline the Neho role calls for.

projects.name: Anand Creations - Forward Deployed AI Practice
projects.description: My independent practice and the home for AI products I ship myself. Same playbook I'd bring to Neho: discovery, prototype in weeks, evals from day one, ship to real users, measure, iterate.

_jobApplication.jobDescription: AI Product Engineer at Neho (Swiss real estate brokerage, SEF Award 2023, fixed-price model). Zero-to-one, reports to CTO. Build agents that remove manual work in buying/financing/selling homes. Ship first agent in months, grow pipeline. Discovery with advisors + ops. Build MCP layer over domain APIs. Ship on containerized fenced path with evals, guardrails, and data-sensitivity respect. Must: modern AI stack (LangGraph/CrewAI/ADK, direct APIs, Dify/n8n), production code experience, PHP/TypeScript/Python across the stack, MCP + webhooks + prompting + streaming UIs, evals + refusals + failure-mode thinking, discovery with real users. Bonus: real estate / mortgages / fintech, Swiss/EU data protection, mobile.
_jobApplication.notes: Perfect fit — Proplab (AI real estate) hits the real-estate nice-to-have directly; SwissNRI hits regulated fintech + Swiss data protection; LumApps hits agents/MCP/evals/guardrails; Zurich-based. Adapted LumApps title to 'Lead AI Product Engineer' to mirror JD.
